designationHistory.name: Muleshoe Migratory Waterfowl Refuge
designationHistory.indexText: Established Oct. 24, 1935, as the Muleshoe Migratory Waterfowl Refuge by Executive Order 7214, signed by President Franklin D. Roosevelt; it is the oldest national wildlife refuge in Texas.
